scope: Two operational decisions only; no repeated v6 tests, pilot, study executions or observation windows

files.controls.py: Use signed effective cost/archive thresholds; historical defaults unchanged
files.handover.py: Verify original authority separately, then signed limit amendment; preserve originals
files.closed_restart.py: v7 paths and dedicated new backup directory
files.runner.py: After verified BACKED_UP/retirement, remove only redundant new staging
files.staging_retention.py: Fail closed on unverified/unsafe paths; never delete sole evidence
files.proposal and review package: Exact limits, costs, inventory and combined-decision procedure

stop: Any failed new control blocks candidate; no broad reruns
